toolLengthMethod.description: Tool length measurement method (0=Fixed position, 1=Surface plate)

ATCType.description: ATC types supported by the system

pulsesPerRevolution.description: Number of pulses per revolution for the stepper motor

revolutionsPerInch.description: Number of revolutions per inch of travel

homingDirectionPositive.description: Whether homing direction is positive (true) or negative (false)

pairedWithAxis.description: Axis number this axis is paired with (-1 if not paired)

label.description: Axis label (X, Y, Z, A, B, C, U, V, W)

turnRatio.description: Turn ratio - distance per revolution (inches/mm per rev for linear, degrees for rotary)

masterAxis.description: Master axis for pairing (0 = none, 1-8 = master axis number)

isRotary.description: Whether this is a rotary axis (Parameter bit 0)

rotaryWrapAround.description: Rotary DRO wrap around display mode (Parameter bit 1)

preventDivideBy360.description: Prevent divide by 360 for C-Axis (Parameter bit 7)

hideFromDRO.description: Hide axis from DRO display - ATC Turret (Parameter bit 9)

parallelToX.description: Rotary axis parallel to X (Parameter bit 11)

parallelToY.description: Rotary axis parallel to Y (Parameter bit 12)

normallyOpen.description: Whether the input is normally open (true) or normally closed (false)

xMinTravel.description: Minimum travel distance for X axis

xMaxTravel.description: Maximum travel distance for X axis

yMinTravel.description: Minimum travel distance for Y axis

yMaxTravel.description: Maximum travel distance for Y axis

zMinTravel.description: Minimum travel distance for Z axis

zMaxTravel.description: Maximum travel distance for Z axis

data.description: Array of data items to save in the checkpoint

CompleteMachineConfiguration.description: Complete machine configuration DTO for API

ConfigurationDataRequest.description: Request model for configuration data operations

stepFrequency.description:
Global step frequency for all axes (steps per second)
Supported values: 100000, 200000, 240000, 300000, 400000

driveFaultDelay.description: Global drive fault delay for all axes (milliseconds)

lowResolutionMode.description: Low resolution mode for plasma systems

IOEvent.description: IO events that can be monitored or triggered

inputSettings.description: Dictionary of input number to invert setting

MachinePoint.description: Represents a point in machine coordinates with X, Y, Z, and A axis values

MoveDirectionUntilRequest.description: Request model for directional movement until an event

MoveToRequest.description: Request model for moving to a specific point

MoveToUntilRequest.description: Request model for moving until an IO event occurs

OverrideIORequest.description: Request model for IO override operations

outputNumber.description: Output number for PWM signal - Required

ParameterSetRequest.description: Request model for setting individual parameters

touchPlateInputNumber.description: Touch plate input number (if different from probe)

encoderCounts.description: Second spindle encoder counts per revolution

SetOutputRequest.description: Request model for setting output values

spindleAxis.description: Spindle axis number (5 standard, 8 for AcornSix/Hickory)

StepFrequencyRequest.description: Request model for setting step frequency

inputType.description: Touch plate input type (0=Normally Open, 1=Normally Closed)
